description: Bounded bilateral AFP Introduction Tier reputation-history proof

encoding.fieldElement: BN254 scalar field element, serialized as a canonical 32-byte big-endian value
encoding.order: Declaration order of pub parameters in noir/zka_reputation/src/main.nr main()
encoding.integers: Unsigned integers are range-constrained by their Noir ABI type and zero-extended into one field element
encoding.byteArrays: [u8; N] occupies N field elements in array order

publicInputs.name: agreement_id_hi
publicInputs.description: High 128 bits of the canonical agreement-id digest

publicInputs.name: agreement_id_lo
publicInputs.description: Low 128 bits of the canonical agreement-id digest

publicInputs.name: counterparty_aid_hi
publicInputs.description: High 128 bits of the verifier/counterparty AID digest

publicInputs.name: counterparty_aid_lo
publicInputs.description: Low 128 bits of the verifier/counterparty AID digest

publicInputs.name: value_scope_hi
publicInputs.description: High 128 bits of the signed single-asset/unit value-scope digest

publicInputs.name: value_scope_lo
publicInputs.description: Low 128 bits of the signed single-asset/unit value-scope digest

publicInputs.name: relationship_pseudonym
publicInputs.description: Agreement/counterparty/value-scope pseudonym derived from the private AFP-KDC per-entity seed

publicInputs.name: history_root
publicInputs.description: Poseidon2 root of the fixed-width bilateral reputation history, authenticated outside the circuit

publicInputs.name: last_commitment_ref_hi
publicInputs.description: High 128 bits of the last active AFP commitment-reference digest

publicInputs.name: last_commitment_ref_lo
publicInputs.description: Low 128 bits of the last active AFP commitment-reference digest

publicInputs.name: reputation_counter
publicInputs.description: Sequence number of the authenticated history head; the verifier enforces monotonic freshness

publicInputs.name: settled_interactions
publicInputs.description: Exact number of active, finally settled clean records in this bounded proof

publicInputs.name: cumulative_settled_value
publicInputs.description: Exact sum of active record values in the signed value scope

publicInputs.name: context
publicInputs.description: Non-zero AFP session/request replay context; AFP sessions use big-endian_uint256(the exact 32-byte X_ payload) mod the BN254 scalar modulus per AFP §15.4
